title: A&M Sea Charters

services.name: Deep-sea Fishing
services.desc: is the pursuit of haddock, cod and wolffish outside of Halifax harbour. Each trip takes place approximately six miles offshore. Each person on the boat is allowed to keep the # of fish determined by the Department of Fisheries and Oceans. Extra fish may be caught, but must be released immediately. - Radio is available on board for your use or you can bring your own to plug in. If you have comments or suggestions, please email me at
